html:
This tour is perfect for travelers looking to escape the crowds and experience the authentic charm of Hoi An’s countryside. Cycle through peaceful villages, learn traditional crafts, and enjoy hands-on experiences that connect you with local culture and everyday life.

HIGHLIGHTS

  • Become a farmer at Tra Que Vegetable Village 🌱

  • Visit Thanh Ha Pottery Village, a heritage village with over 500 years of history 🏺

  • Try making your own pottery as a unique souvenir 🎨

  • Enjoy a scenic biking route through the countryside 🚴

ITINERARY

Morning

  • Hotel pick-up and transfer to Tra Que Vegetable Village.

  • Experience daily farming life and learn how locals grow fresh herbs and vegetables.

  • Relax with a traditional Vietnamese herbal foot soak.

  • Enjoy a farm-to-table lunch at a local restaurant.

Afternoon

  • Cycle approximately 6 km to Thanh Ha Pottery Village.

  • Witness skilled artisans crafting beautiful ceramics.

  • Hands-on experience: make your own pottery piece.

  • Return to your hotel with a comfortable ride.

Note: This itinerary is flexible and can be customized to match your preferences.

TOUR PRICE: USD 25 / person

INCLUSIONS

  • Hotel pick-up and drop-off service 🚗

  • Experienced English-speaking tour guide 🎤

  • Entrance fees to all attractions 🎟️

  • Lunch at a local restaurant 🍛

  • Bicycle for countryside biking 🚴

  • Bottled water (1 bottle per person) 💧

EXCLUSIONS

  • Personal expenses

  • Services not mentioned above

  • Tax
